findings: Source splits ordered population using KFold(10,shuffle=True,random_state=42), then selects final branch/version fold IDs.
Training loader shuffles and drops incomplete batches; validation loader retains population order and incomplete batches. Preparation is called per access, preserving resampled augmentation.

Final branch training saves terminal model state, not best-validation selection. Temporal optional periodic checkpoints are disabled by final configuration; single branch has no periodic checkpoint option.
Validation and external scoring are observed during training; source loop does not use either to select best checkpoint.
